title: A Clockwork Orange

vibeProfile.oneLine: A violent youth is 'cured' of his free will, in Burgess's invented slang.

summary: In a near-future England, the teenage Alex leads a gang on nightly sprees of 'ultra-violence', narrating it all in Nadsat, the invented Russian-tinged slang Burgess created for him, until the state seizes him for an experimental cure that strips away his ability to choose evil, or good. A dazzling, disturbing fable about free will, conditioning and the morality of the state, it is as unsettling as it is inventive. Short, ferocious and unlike anything else, with a language you learn as you read.
whyReadIt: A ferocious, inventive fable about free will and state control, told in its own invented slang. Disturbing and unforgettable.

funFacts.text: Burgess invented an entire teen slang, Nadsat, based largely on Russian, for the novel.
